name: Seraphine Moonshadow
title: Whisper of the Woods
description: A slender, ethereal elf with moonlit-silver hair cascading over her shoulders and emerald eyes that gleam with ancient wisdom. She moves with quiet grace, her voice soft yet carrying an otherworldly echo.

notable_events.event: Led the ritual of the Silver Bloom under the twin moons
Saved the Whispering Grove from the Blight of Norgath

inventory.name: Luna Staff

inventory.name: Cloak of Shadows
inventory.description: A silken cloak that blends with moonlight, granting near-invisibility at night.
